label: Takeaway
detail: UNOH went 38-18 and 25-3 in the WHAC, its third straight regular-season title, then went 1-2 in the WHAC Tournament and 2-2 at the NAIA Opening Round. No 2027 roster is posted, so by class it keeps 70% of 2026 plate appearances and 43% of innings. Grau (.404, 74 RBI) and Healy (3.10 ERA) are back by class; Otero, Romero, Cabell and Bobolia were seniors.

label: Method
detail: No 2027 roster is posted. Back means a 2026 player listed as a freshman, sophomore or junior. Listed seniors count as out. Transfers and departures since the season aren't known, so these shares can run high.

label: Season
detail: 38-18 followed 40-15-1 in 2025. UNOH scored 502 runs and allowed 333, hit .330 and set a program record with a .443 on-base percentage, per its recap. It went 16-0 at home in Lima.

label: Postseason
detail: WHAC Tournament, Rockford and Grand Rapids, Apr 30-May 1: lost to Cornerstone 7-4, beat Aquinas 10-1, then lost to Lawrence Tech 11-1. NAIA Opening Round at Lawrenceville, Ga., May 11-13: lost to Talladega 12-2, beat No. 23 Marian 1-0 and Talladega 9-5, then lost to No. 24 Louisiana Christian 16-3.

label: lu_proj
detail: Built from 2026 box scores, using only players who can return by class. Each spot goes to the returner with the most 2026 starts there. Order is by 2026 OPS, so small samples rank high. Set means 20 or more starts at the spot, Likely 8 or more.

label: lu_most
detail: A typical 2026 lineup, built from all 56 box scores. Each position goes to the player with the most starts there, using each player once and keeping as many of those starts as possible; the DH spot counts only starts at DH. The order is each player's average spot across all his 2026 starts, lowest first. No one started half the games at DH (Green, 23) or right (Barnes, 22), so those spots were shared. 2027 outlook is the same status used on the rest of this page.

label: lu_all
detail: UNOH used 50 different lineups in 56 games. A lineup counts as the same only with the same nine in the same order at the same positions.

label: rot_proj
detail: The same 2026 stats, with projected 2027 roles for pitchers who can return by class. Listed seniors made 39 of the 56 starts. With no 2027 roster posted, these are role guesses from 2026 usage.

label: Staff
detail: Main starters made at least 4 starts. Relievers made at least 5 relief outings and aren't main starters. GS and Relief are published totals.

label: Maps
detail: 3 of the 42 players with a listed hometown are from Michigan, so this map is nearly empty. 20 list Ohio, where UNOH plays, and show on the national map below.

label: League
detail: UNOH ranked 2nd of 11 WHAC teams in runs per game (8.96) and 1st in on-base percentage (.443). On the mound it ranked 4th in ERA (5.70) and 1st in strikeouts per nine (9.28).

label: Method
detail: wOBA uses standard big-league weights. FIP uses a constant that sets the NAIA-wide FIP equal to NAIA ERA. Rank 1 is best in every row. UNOH's numbers are from NAIA stats, and its WHAC rank is out of 11 teams because Rochester Christian isn't listed. OPS is worked out from NAIA's rounded on-base and slugging figures, so it shows .943 here and .942 on UNOH's sheet.

label: Filter
detail: All games shows UNOH's published totals. Any other filter is added up from box scores and play-by-play, game by game. The filter changes the Hitters, Pitchers and Tendencies tabs. Player cards always show the full season.

label: Outing log
detail: Days of rest counts full calendar days since the pitcher's previous appearance, whatever the filter. Pitch counts show a dash when a box score lists none.

label: Cesar Grau
detail: Grau hit .404 with a 1.185 OPS, 24 doubles, 8 homers and 74 RBI, program records for doubles and RBI per the recap. He was a second-team NAIA All-American as a junior and can return by class.

label: Scoring
detail: UNOH scored 8.96 runs a game in NAIA stats, 2nd of 11 in the WHAC and 17th of 179 in the NAIA. It hit .330, 1st in the WHAC, and was hit by 127 pitches.

label: League play
detail: UNOH went 25-3 in the WHAC and outscored those opponents 336-135, hitting .381 with a 4.65 ERA in those 28 games. Its losses came at Lawrence Tech, Siena Heights and Madonna. It swept both Indiana Tech games and both Cleary games.

label: Top of the rotation
detail: Healy went 10-2 with a 3.10 ERA and 6 complete games in 14 starts, and was WHAC Pitcher of the Year for the second straight year. Cabell, a listed senior, went 6-4 with a 3.70 ERA and 84 strikeouts. Every other pitcher with 10 or more innings had an ERA of 4.45 or higher.

label: Against ranked teams
detail: It beat No. 5 Tennessee Wesleyan 12-4, No. 6 Cumberlands once in three tries, No. 19 Indiana Tech twice and No. 23 Marian 1-0. It lost three times to No. 18 Johnson (Tenn.) and once to No. 24 Louisiana Christian. Ranks are as printed on UNOH's schedule page.

label: Where the roster comes from
detail: 20 of 42 list an Ohio hometown and 3 a Michigan one. 3 list Ontario, two Venezuela and one Puerto Rico, and the rest are spread over 14 other states and countries.

label: How players arrive
detail: From the Previous College line on each player's bio page: 24 of 42 came straight from high school, 14 from junior colleges and 4 from four-year schools (Indiana State, Siena, Tiffin and York of Pennsylvania). Clark State CC sent three, the most of any school. Grau came from North Central Missouri College and Grigalis from San Jacinto.

label: No 2027 roster
detail: UNOH hasn't published its 2026-27 roster or schedule. Every 2027 status here comes from the 2026 class: seniors count as gone and everyone else as able to return.

label: Earned runs
detail: The individual pitching lines add up to 267 earned runs, while the team line on the same sheet says 264. Each pitcher's ERA matches his own line, so this page keeps them as published.

label: Hit by pitch
detail: Tappenden's official line has 3 hit batters and the box scores 2.

label: Caught stealing
detail: Play-by-play shows UNOH caught 20 times and the official sheet 24. Some outs on the bases aren't written as caught stealing.

label: Some games have no real counts
detail: 14 of the 56 box scores have no usable counts. Those games are left out of the count and pitch stats.

label: Season records
detail: Bio and schedule pages differ by a game in a few seasons. The chart uses the schedule pages: 2017 shows 44-13 there and 44-12 in Hartman's bio.

label: Roster
detail: The roster list page has no previous colleges, so they come from each player's bio page (captured Nov 6, 2026). Parker Close is listed without a number and Darlison and Close without full details.

label: Map sources
detail: Hometowns are from UNOH's roster. I entered coordinates by hand, so towns are approximate. The two Venezuela hometowns are off the map. Shapes come from U.S. Census and Natural Earth.

label: Checked by arithmetic
detail: The game log adds to 38-18, 502 runs scored and 333 allowed, and to 25-3 in WHAC games. Box score batting totals tie to the official sheet in every column but caught stealing, and every pitcher's decisions match.

label: Box scores are from NAIA stats
detail: All 56 games are on NAIA stats, captured Nov 6, 2026.

label: Play-by-play gaps
detail: Two box scores leave plays out of the play-by-play: one of Otero's hits on Feb 21 and most of Tappenden's outing on Apr 6 (box score 2 hits, 3 walks and 3 strikeouts; play-by-play 0, 1 and 1). Season and box score lines use the box score.

label: Projections
detail: Projected lineups and staffs come from public numbers and class. UNOH has published no depth chart.

label: Commits
detail: No commit list for UNOH was checked.

label: Spray charts are partial
detail: Spray charts use 1,283 of Northwestern Ohio's 1,744 at-bats (74%): 92% of balls in play, 81% of hits (468 of 575) and 99% of everything else (815 of 821). Strikeouts have no direction. Scorers skip the direction on hits far more often than on outs, so charts can understate hits. Zones are where the scorer placed the ball, not exact spots.

label: Direction corrected
detail: Double plays were being credited to the relay throw instead of the first fielder, and plays written with the last name first or an error by a fielder had no direction. I corrected that on Nov 4, which moved Pull, Center and Oppo a few points for some hitters and raised the direction counts.

label: Runs by inning
detail: UNOH scored most in the 2nd (92 runs) and 61 in the 1st. It scored 61 from the 7th on, though 7-inning games shorten that count.

label: Runs allowed
detail: Opponents scored most in the 4th, 68 runs, and 55 in the 1st.

label: Steals
detail: Play-by-play shows 89 steals of second, 4 of third and 4 of home, of 97 published.

label: Where UNOH has the edge
detail: Batting average .330 to .320, on-base percentage .443 to .433, slugging .499 to .453, OPS .943 to .886, wOBA .415 to .393, runs per game 8.96 to 7.69, homers per game 0.80 to 0.40, steals per game 1.73 to 1.44, FIP 5.59 to 6.11, strikeouts per nine 9.28 to 8.53, walks plus hit batters per nine 6.41 to 7.29, homers allowed per nine 0.52 to 0.56.

label: Where Cleary has the edge
detail: Walk rate 13.4% to 11.5%, strikeout rate 14.1% to 16.0%, WHIP 1.58 to 1.67, fielding percentage .968 to .956.

label: Series
detail: UNOH won both meetings in 2026, 8-5 and 7-6 in 11 innings, on Apr 11 in Lima. Since 2019 it leads 12-4.

label: Apr 11: UNOH 8, Cleary 5
detail: Healy started for UNOH (4.2 IP, 4 ER) and Noseworthy for Cleary (2.0 IP, 4 ER). Otero went 2-for-4 for UNOH, and Seman went 3-for-4 for Cleary.

label: Apr 11: UNOH 7, Cleary 6 (11 innings)
detail: Cabell started for UNOH (6.1 IP, 3 ER) and Lieng for Cleary (3.2 IP, 3 ER). Grau went 3-for-6 for UNOH, and Vincent went 3-for-5 for Cleary.

label: Method
detail: With All games selected, every number in this view counts all 56 games, from box scores and play-by-play. Ground outs include sacrifices and fielder's choices, and air outs include sacrifice flies.

label: Partial
detail: Scorers didn't enter these details for every game, so each number covers only part of the season. Treat them as samples. The first two tables show what's missing.

label: Splits
detail: Innings and time through the order use every plate appearance. Time through the order is each pitcher's batters faced in that game divided by nine, so substitutions can shift it slightly.

label: Splits
detail: Only plate appearances with a count listed. The count is where the plate appearance stood before its final pitch. Two strikes and Full count overlap the other rows.

label: Ground and air outs
detail: Hull has 1.45 ground outs per air out, the most among regulars (100 or more plate appearances), and Huffman has 0.42.

label: How long arms go
detail: Healy averages 5.8 innings a start, Cabell 5.2 and Bobolia 4.1.

label: Groundball and fly-ball arms
detail: Lybarger has 1.77 ground outs per air out, the most among pitchers with 100 batters faced, and Curi has 0.61.

label: First-pitch swings
detail: Among regulars with pitch data on 60 or more plate appearances, Grigalis swings at the most first pitches, 41% on 160. Huffman swings at the fewest, 13% on 67.

label: Swing and miss
detail: Green whiffs on 10% of swings, the fewest among regulars with pitch data on 60 or more plate appearances, and Watson on 31%.

label: Direction
detail: Grau pulls 54% of his batted balls, the most among regulars, on 147 with a direction. Watson pulls 26%, on 103.

label: Pitch counts
detail: Healy averages 93 pitches a start and Cabell 88. Healy's most was 117. Averages use only outings with a listed count.
